param: A Recruitment (birth) rate into susceptible population
μ Natural death rate (applies to all compartments)
β Effective transmission / successful infection rate (mass-action incidence)
ε Correction parameter for reinfection term (relative susceptibility of recovered); 0..1
u Vaccination rate moving susceptible to vaccinated
θ Vaccine waning rate moving vaccinated back to susceptible
γ Recovery rate moving infected to recovered
δ Waning natural immunity rate moving recovered back to susceptible
